meta.title: Megafrut – Fresh fruit exporter
meta.description: Megafrut is a Chilean agricultural exporter based in San Fernando, O’Higgins Region. Export cherries, nectarines, pears, Red Globe grapes and kiwis. GLOBALG.A.P. certified.

hero.title: Fresh Chilean fruit, delivered to your market.
hero.subtitle: Cherries, kiwis, nectarines, pears and Red Globe grapes selected at origin and shipped with a focus on freshness and quality.

fruits.title: Our export fruit
fruits.subtitle: Five varieties, one quality standard from orchard to destination.

cert.title: GLOBALG.A.P. certification
cert.text: We hold GLOBALG.A.P. certification, an international standard for good agricultural practices.

items.title: Over 30 years of experience
items.text: Since 1993 we have worked with fresh Chilean fruit for international markets.

items.title: From the O’Higgins Region
items.text: We operate from San Fernando, one of Chile’s fruit-growing areas.

items.title: Five fruits, November to April
items.text: Cherries, nectarines, pears, Red Globe grapes and kiwis, each in its season.

location.title: Where to find us
location.text: Visit us at our farm, located in the San Fernando area.
location.label: Address
location.name: Megafrut y Sociedad Agrícola Los Lingues
location.address: Camino I-113, San Fernando, O’Higgins Region

jobs.title: Work with us
jobs.text: Want to be part of the Megafrut team? Send us your résumé and tell us which area you would like to work in.

contact.title: Let’s talk about your next order
contact.text: Tell us which fruit you need, the volume and destination, and we’ll get back to you shortly.
